intent.proves: At least one favourite list with products exists.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomCustomerFavoriteLists l WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomCustomerFavoriteProducts p WHERE p.FavoriteListId = l.Id)

sources.ref: DW10 database schema (INFORMATION_SCHEMA of a local DW10 install) and Dynamicweb.Ecommerce 10.29.8
